name: Plausible sampled Core Web Vitals
purpose: Measure aggregate LCP, INP, and CLS quality buckets after mobile performance releases.

idempotency.source: one in-memory send guard per sampled page navigation
idempotency.not_supported: provider does not accept a client idempotency key

rate_limit.expected: five percent of production page navigations; at most one event per available metric
rate_limit.on_429: drop the optional measurement without retry

observability.metric: Plausible custom event named Web Vital

degradation.user_visible_fallback: none; reading and advertising continue when observers or analytics are unavailable

privacy.personal_data: none added by the RUM event
